front: In Amazon GuardDuty, a finding is kept for at most {{c1::90 days}}.
In AWS Config, configuration items are kept by default for {{c1::7 years (2557 days)}}.
In Amazon S3, a company must find credit card numbers in objects across many buckets with the LEAST operational overhead. What do you use?
back: Amazon Macie, with its managed data identifiers.
extra: Macie managed data identifiers detect [credit card numbers and bank account numbers](../facts/macie.md#macie-managed-data-identifiers).

front: GuardDuty or Inspector: which one finds a software package with a known vulnerability (CVE) on an EC2 instance?
extra: Inspector scans workloads for [software vulnerabilities and unintended network exposure](../facts/inspector.md#inspector-dg-vulnerabilities-exposure).

front: Amazon Macie stores sensitive data discovery results {{c1::for only 90 days}} unless you configure an S3 bucket for them.
In Amazon GuardDuty, the EventBridge event for repeated occurrences of a finding is sent by default every {{c1::6 hours}}.
In AWS Config, can a Config rule stop a noncompliant change before it happens?
back: No. The rule evaluates the change after it is recorded.
extra: [AWS Config rules do not prevent the user](../facts/config.md#config-faq-rules-evaluate-after-change-not-prevent) from making a noncompliant change.

front: AWS Config or AWS CloudTrail: which one tells you who made the API call that changed a resource?
extra: CloudTrail [records user API activity on your account](../facts/config.md#config-faq-cloudtrail-records-api-activity), with the identity of the caller.

front: After a GuardDuty finding, a team must find its root cause without writing its own queries. What do you use?
extra: Detective helps you [identify the root cause of security findings](../facts/detective.md#detective-dg-root-cause).

front: A security team needs one list of the GuardDuty, Inspector and Macie findings to triage. What do you use?
extra: Security Hub CSPM [also receives findings from other AWS services](../facts/security-hub.md#security-hub-cspm-receives-service-findings), such as GuardDuty, Inspector and Macie.

front: An auditor needs the AWS SOC report about the AWS data centers. Where do you download it?
extra: AWS Artifact provides [on-demand downloads of AWS security and compliance documents](../facts/artifact.md#artifact-guide-on-demand-compliance-documents).

front: In Amazon GuardDuty, must you create VPC flow logs before GuardDuty can analyze flow log data?
back: No. Your own flow log settings stay as they are.
extra: [You don't need to create or configure](../facts/guardduty.md#guardduty-flow-logs-not-required) VPC flow logs for GuardDuty to access this data.
